title: Agenda for Thursday's weekly sync
text:
Hi Wop,

Here's the agenda for Thursday's weekly sync (10 AM, 45 minutes). Could you take notes in Notion like last week?

1. Launch checklist for Nov 2 - you (10 min)
2. Matching service v0.3: group size fix and API speed - Daniel (10 min)
3. Android 15 push notification bug - Sam (5 min)
4. Onboarding redesign and final app icon - Priya (5 min)
5. Westbrook beta feedback, including the library room booking request - Tomás will join by video (10 min)
6. Harbor Seed Fund: Lena's partner meeting is Oct 30 - me (5 min)

Reminder: the database migration is Saturday night, so please don't plan any testing then.

See you Thursday,
Maya Chen
Co-founder & CEO, Pairly
